args.sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        m.id AS movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes
    FROM imdb_movies.main.director_mapping dm
    JOIN imdb_movies.main.names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN imdb_movies.main.movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN imdb_movies.main.ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
inter_movie AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        date_published,
        LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) AS prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        date_diff('day', prev_date, date_published) AS diff
    FROM inter_movie
    WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
),
avg_inter_movie AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        ROUND(AVG(diff)) AS avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM inter_movie_diff
    GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
    dm.name_id,
    dm.name,
    COUNT(dm.movie_id) AS number_of_movies,
    COALESCE(aim.avg_inter_movie_duration, 0) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(dm.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(dm.total_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(dm.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(dm.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(dm.duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM director_movies dm
LEFT JOIN avg_inter_movie aim ON dm.name_id = aim.name_id
GROUP BY dm.name_id, dm.name, aim.avg_inter_movie_duration
ORDER BY number_of_movies DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

    FROM imdb_movies.main.director_mapping dm

SELECT 
    dm.name_id,
    n.name,
    COUNT(m.id) AS number_of_movies,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(m.id) > 1 THEN ROUND(date_diff('day', MIN(m.date_published::DATE), MAX(m.date_published::DATE)) / (COUNT(m.id) - 1))
        ELSE 0 
    END AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(m.duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM imdb_movies.main.director_mapping dm
JOIN imdb_movies.main.names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
JOIN imdb_movies.main.movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
JOIN imdb_movies.main.ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name
ORDER BY number_of_movies DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT 
    dm.name_id AS id,
    n.name,
    COUNT(m.id) AS number_of_movies,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(m.id) > 1 THEN ROUND(date_diff('day', MIN(m.date_published::DATE), MAX(m.date_published::DATE)) / (COUNT(m.id) - 1))::INT
        ELSE 0 
    END AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes)::INT AS total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(m.duration)::INT AS total_movie_duration
FROM imdb_movies.main.director_mapping dm
JOIN imdb_movies.main.names n ON dm.name_id = n.id

JOIN imdb_movies.main.ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name
ORDER BY number_of_movies DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;
